system.description: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.
system.notes:
Champion | Leader

A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.
Motives & Tactics: Create thralls, charm, command, fly, intimidate

Difficulty: 20 | Thresholds: 14/28 | HP: 6 | Stress: 6

ATK: +5 | Weapon: Melee | 2d12+4 physical

Experience: Aristocrat +3, Nocturnal Hunter +3

Features

Terrifying - Passive: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

Look into My Eyes - Passive: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain 1d4 Fear.

Feed on Followers - Action: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP and rolls their next action roll with Advantage.

The Hunt Is On - Action: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

Dreadful Riposte - Reaction: When a PC misses the Vampire with Fear, the Vampire may make an attack roll against them. On a hit, this attack deals direct damage.

Mistform - Reaction: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can spend a Fear to take half damage.

Blood Rain - Reaction: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a d8. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP and roll their next action roll with Disadvantage.
